description: The Porsche 911 Turbo S “Sadu Edition” is an ultra-exclusive Kuwait-market special limited to just 20 examples, created to celebrate 70 years of Porsche in Kuwait. Its defining feature is the integration of traditional Al Sadu weaving patterns into the exterior graphics and bespoke interior textiles, blending Kuwaiti cultural heritage with Porsche Exclusive Manufaktur craftsmanship.
creator: kuroi
